title: Grail CF 7 official product page
notes: Current exact product 4149 page specifies 9.26 kg in size M, Shimano GRX mechanical 2x12 with RX610 controls, RD-RX820, FD-RX820, RX600 46/30 crank and Shimano 105 R7101 11-34 cassette, plus 42 mm maximum clearance for frame and fork. The weight basis is the standard specification with no pedals included.
